# Closed-HIGH/CRITICAL real-data pins — one per line: "<lane> <test title>".
#
# The lane names the cargo target (see `scripts/run-real-data-pins.sh`); the title
# is a libtest substring filter and each pin runs in its own process, which is the
# memory bound (one `parse_real_esm.rs` process that loads every master spikes
# past 20 GB). The runner refuses a green no-op, so a typo'd title fails rather
# than passing vacuously, and `workspace_hygiene_tests`
# (`every_real_data_pin_names_an_ignored_test_in_its_lane`) checks on every
# hosted run that each title is a real `#[ignore]`d `fn` in its lane's sources.
#
# New closed-HIGH pins append here. Lanes: plugin-lib, plugin-esm, bin, nif-corpus.
# Run them with `scripts/run-real-data-pins.sh [filter]` (#5799, #6182, #6183).
